parsed_json.up: Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by the document ChEMBL ID. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return the results sorted by molecule ChEMBL ID.
